en.short: Method overriding means a subclass rewrites a method it inherits, keeping the same name and parameters. Which version runs is decided at runtime by the object's actual type. This is called dynamic method dispatch.
en.detailed: Method overriding happens when a subclass gives its own body to a method it inherits, keeping the same name, parameters and return type. When the method is called through a parent class reference, Java looks at the object's actual type at runtime and runs that version. This is called dynamic method dispatch. Example: if Circle overrides area() from Shape, then Shape s = new Circle(); s.area(); runs Circle's area(). Use super.method() to call the parent class version.

kn.detailed: Method overriding ಎಂದರೆ, subclass ತಾನು inherit ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡ method ಗೆ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ body ಕೊಡುವುದು; ಹೆಸರು, parameters ಮತ್ತು return type ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. Parent class ನ reference ಮೂಲಕ method ಅನ್ನು ಕರೆದಾಗ, ಯಾವ version ಚಲಾಯಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು Java runtime ನಲ್ಲಿ object ನ ನಿಜವಾದ type ನೋಡಿ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನೇ dynamic method dispatch ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಉದಾಹರಣೆ: Circle class, Shape ನ area() ಅನ್ನು override ಮಾಡಿದರೆ, Shape s = new Circle(); s.area(); ಎಂದು ಕರೆದಾಗ Circle ನ area() ಚಲಾಯಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ. hi.short: Method overriding का मतलब है कि subclass, inherit किए गए method को उसी नाम और उन्हीं parameters के साथ दोबारा लिखती है। कौन-सा method चलेगा, यह runtime पर object के असली type से तय होता है। इसे dynamic method dispatch कहते हैं।
hi.detailed: Method overriding में subclass, inherit किए गए method को अपनी body देती है; नाम, parameters और return type वही रहते हैं। जब parent class के reference से method को call किया जाता है, तब Java runtime पर object का असली type देखकर तय करता है कि कौन-सा version चलेगा। इसे dynamic method dispatch कहते हैं। उदाहरण: अगर Circle class, Shape के area() को override करती है, तो Shape s = new Circle(); s.area(); चलाने पर Circle का area() चलेगा। Parent class का version चाहिए तो super.method() लिखें।

Java Programming.q: Which keyword calls the parent class version of an overridden method?
Java Programming.why: super refers to the immediate parent class, so super.show() runs the parent's show().

Java Programming.q: Which of these methods can NOT be overridden?
Java Programming.why: final stops a method from being overridden. Abstract methods must be overridden.

Java Programming.q: Dynamic method dispatch decides which method runs based on…
Java Programming.why: At runtime Java looks at the object, not the reference. That's runtime polymorphism.

Java Programming.q: Java doesn't allow multiple inheritance with classes mainly to avoid…
Java Programming.why: Two parents with the same method would make the call ambiguous. Interfaces solve this safely.

Java Programming.q: Which block always runs, whether or not an exception is thrown?
Java Programming.why: finally runs after try/catch every time, which is why it's used to close files and connections.
